release_notes:
- New "Reading comfort" option (⚙️ → Reading comfort): a one-click "Easy reading" profile for dyslexia, low vision or tired eyes, with a clearer font, more spacing and a warm background. It only changes the places where you read (abstracts, notes, annotations, guides, Help chat), applies at once and is remembered.
- AI batches in economy mode are no longer lost: if you close the app or reload the page while a full-text, risk-of-bias or title/abstract batch is running, Nexus SR picks it up when you come back and tells you when it is ready.
- AI Screening (title/abstract): results now wait for you until you apply them, even if you close the window or the app, and there is a new "Discard results" button. You cannot start a second batch while one is running or while results are waiting.
- AI Screening: with Nexus AI, the "Fast / Economy" choice now appears (it was hidden), and the AI windows show "Nexus AI" instead of "Ollama".
- Risk of bias AI pre-fill now costs half: 3 AI ops per study instead of 6 (9 instead of 16 with Sonnet).
- ROBINS-I AI pre-fill no longer gets cut off: it answers every question with short, sourced rationales. The ROBINS-I batch asks which outcome the assessments belong to.
- Risk of bias: "Clear all" clears only the outcome you are looking at. "Copy to another outcome" makes an exact copy and warns you if the target already has an assessment.
- ROBINS-I: the Word report is for the outcome you are viewing, and report file names include the outcome, so two outcomes no longer overwrite each other.
- Risk of bias charts: two studies with the same label, like two "Smith (2020)", no longer merge into one row, and surnames such as "Sammoud S" show correctly.
- Citations: marks with several sources, such as [@doi:a; @pmid:b] (what the Library copies when you select several records), now resolve, and a page locator like [@doi:x, p. 23] reaches the citation. Saving a style keeps it selected.
- PRISMA: a library called "Include" or "Incluidos" now counts in the included boxes.
- macOS: reinstalling the app no longer deletes your saved PRISMA diagrams and search strategies.
- Manuscript Reviewer warns you if a review reached its length limit, and Claim-to-Citation tells you how many short sentences it did not analyse.
- More of Meta-analysis and Data Extraction is translated into Spanish, and a few texts that promised features that do not exist yet have been removed.
